title: Training and Support Systems for Talented Singapore Athletes Considering Professional Sporting Careers
what_it_is: Training and Support Systems for Talented Singapore Athletes Considering Professional Sporting Careers

sections.label: Support for Team Singapore athletes
sections.summary: MCCY and SportSG support Team Singapore athletes through grants, coaching, sports science, education schemes and career development networks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: One of the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth's (MCCY's) priorities is to enable our Team Singapore athletes to reach their full potential and achieve sporting success when they represent Singapore in international competitions, such as the Olympics and Southeast Asian Games.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Sport Singapore (SportSG) partners stakeholders, such as the National Sports Associations (NSAs), to support our athletes by providing financial grants, coaching, sports science and sports medicine expertise, as well as overseas training and competition opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: SportSG also supports the personal development of Team Singapore athletes through its Athlete Life Management (ALM) programme, which helps athletes cope with the demands of high-performance sports, while pursuing education goals and preparing for a successful transition to a post-sport career.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In 2013, the Singapore Sports Institute (SSI) set up the Sports Excellence Business (spexBusiness) Network to offer career development opportunities to active and retired Team Singapore athletes, including internships, apprenticeships, part-time positions, as well as permanent positions with flexible work arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: There are now 58 corporate partners in the network, and over 220 Team Singapore athletes have benefited from the network.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In addition, SSI has partnered 12 Institutes of Higher Learning under its spexEducation Scheme to support student-athletes with flexible academic arrangements to help them balance the demands of both sport and academic development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To date, over 400 student-athletes have benefited from this scheme.

sections.label: Deloitte sponsorship reference guide
sections.summary: In 2016, SSI partnered Deloitte to develop a guide for Team Singapore athletes on securing and retaining corporate sponsorships.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In 2016, SSI partnered Deloitte to develop a reference guide for Team Singapore athletes on how to secure, maintain and retain corporate sponsorships as a professional athlete.
